title: Gyökeres handball at the Emirates: unnaturally bigger, or just a hit?
description:
Arsenal 1-1 Borussia Dortmund, Champions League league phase, Emirates Stadium, Tuesday 24 November 2026. Viktor Gyökeres puts Arsenal 1-0 up early. In the second half (51st minute in two reports), a Dortmund corner strikes Gyökeres on the arm inside the Arsenal box. Referee Maurizio Mariani plays on: no penalty and no on-field review. Maximilian Beier equalises in the 55th minute and it finishes 1-1, leaving Dortmund seventh on 10 points and Arsenal fifth on 11.

Under Law 12, not every touch of the hand or arm is an offence; it is one if the arm has made the body "unnaturally bigger", meaning its position is not justified by the player's movement in that situation.

Reports differ on whether VAR checked the incident at all (Football Insider: checked and saw nothing wrong; Goal and africasoccer: not reviewed), and that is shown as disputed. Former referee Keith Hackett (Football Insider) and former Bundesliga referee Patrick Ittrich (to Prime Video, via getfootballnewsgermany) both say it was a penalty; each is one report, not cross-verified. Dortmund coach Niko Kovač: "I thought VAR should have looked at the handball."

Sources: Goal, Football Insider, Britbrief, Roundtable, africasoccer, getfootballnewsgermany, sportsnewsreport, The FA's Laws of the Game 2026/27 (Law 12). Rebuilt from match reports: positions are illustrative, not to scale. No view taken on the officials.
